author: RATTLEWARRIOR
body:
After a while, i have become tired of going to the https://avicus.net everytime i want to see which of my friends(and yes i have them), are on. i cantt remember really who i can /where the person, so i think it would be a cool feature to see what friends on your "friends list" are on. i also have tried /friend add [username], and i dont have permission. probably just myself, but it would also be cool to add your friends ingame.




 
 
  thank,
 
 
 
 
 
 

 
 -Miles
